title: mentha arvensis f. tenuifolia
intro: Mentha arvensis f. tenuifolia, commonly known as Japanese Wild Mint, is a subspecies of the plant Mentha arvensis, which is a type of mint native to Europe, Asia, and North America. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe digestive issues and reduce fever. The therapeutic actions of Mentha arvensis f. tenuifolia include its ability to act as an anti-spasmodic, carminative, and diaphoretic, making it useful for relieving symptoms of colds, flu, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include menthone, limonene, and menthol, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
